terms.title: Terms of Use
body: # Terms of Use

These terms apply to Super Tracker ("the app"), a free companion app for Helldivers 2 made by {{owner}} ("we", "us"). By installing or using the app you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
## 1. An unofficial fan project
{{disclaimer}} The app is free and is offered as a hobby project.
## 2. Who can use it
You must be at least 18 years old. Helldivers 2 is rated PEGI 18 / ESRB M, and the app contains social features for adults.
## 3. Your content
- You are responsible for everything you post, upload or submit: cases, evidence, loadouts, comments, profile details and similar content.
- Only share content you made yourself or have the right to share.

- You keep ownership of your content. You give us a free, non-exclusive, worldwide license to store, copy and show it inside the app for as long as it is published there. The license ends when you delete the content, except for copies we must keep by law or that remain in backups for a short time.
- Your content must follow the [Community Guidelines](#/legal/guidelines) and the [Roleplay Notice](#/legal/roleplay).
## 4. Roleplay features

Treason cases, verdicts, warrants, the alignment meter and the bounty board are fictional, in-universe roleplay about gameplay. They are not statements of fact about real people. Using them to harass, threaten or defame anyone is forbidden.
## 5. Copyright complaints

If you believe content in the app infringes your copyright or other rights, email {{email}} with the content (a link or description), the work or right concerned, and how to reach you. We remove infringing content as soon as reasonably possible, and accounts that infringe repeatedly are closed.
## 6. Removal and suspension

We may remove content, or suspend or close accounts, that break these terms, the Community Guidelines or the law, or that put other players at risk. Anyone named in a Treason case can ask for its removal from inside the app.
## 7. The app itself
- The app's code, design and texts are {{copyright}} You may use the official builds. You may not copy, modify, redistribute or sell the app or builds of it.
- Third-party components keep their own licenses; see [Licenses](#/legal/licenses).
- Game data shown in the app is approximate, comes from community sources and may be wrong.
## 8. No warranty, limited liability

The app is provided "as is", without any warranty. It may contain errors and may change or stop at any time. To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for any loss or damage from using it, including lost game progress, actions the game's publisher takes on your game account, or content posted by other users.
## 9. Your game account
The app never reads the game's memory, files or network traffic and never sends input to the game. You remain responsible for following the game's own terms and code of conduct.
## 10. Changes
We may update these terms. When the version changes, the app asks you to accept the new version before you continue.
## 11. Law and contact
These terms are governed by the laws of {{country}}, without limiting any mandatory consumer rights you have where you live. Questions: {{email}}.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice
body: # Privacy Notice

This notice explains what Super Tracker stores about you, where, and why. It is written for the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK, Law No. 6698) and, for users in the European Economic Area, the GDPR.
## Who is responsible
Data controller: {{owner}}, {{country}}. Contact: {{email}}.
## Right now, everything stays on your PC
The current version has no accounts and no server. What you do in the app stays on your computer:
- **Settings and activity** (theme, accepted terms, favorites, votes, cases and drafts you create) are stored in the app's local storage.
- **Images and videos you pick** are copied into the app's data folder on your PC.
You can remove all of it by uninstalling the app and deleting its data folders (%APPDATA%\com.supertracker.app and %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.supertracker.app).
## Network requests
The app connects to:
- **GitHub** (github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com) to check for updates and to download game content and these legal texts.
- Later, the **community Helldivers 2 API** (api.helldivers2.dev) for live war data.
Like any website, these services see your IP address and basic request details and handle them under their own privacy policies. We do not receive or store this information.
## What we do not do
- No analytics, tracking or advertising profiles.
- No selling or sharing of personal data.
- The app does not read the game's memory, files or network traffic.
## Online accounts (coming later)

Online accounts and shared content are planned. Before they launch, this notice will list what account data is collected (such as email address, callsign, avatar and uploaded images), where it is stored, how long it is kept and how to export or delete it, and the app will ask you to review it.
## Your rights

Under KVKK (Article 11) and the GDPR you can ask whether we process your data, get a copy, have it corrected or deleted, object to processing, and complain to the supervisory authority (in Türkiye: the Personal Data Protection Authority, KVKK). Because the current version keeps your data only on your PC, you can exercise most of these rights yourself. For anything else, email {{email}}.
## Age
The app is for people aged 18 and over.
## Changes
We update this notice when the app changes what it stores, and the version number changes with every update.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
body: # Community Guidelines
Super Tracker is for players who enjoy Helldivers 2 together. These rules apply to everything you share in the app: cases, evidence, loadouts, comments and profiles.
## Be a good squadmate
- No harassment, bullying, threats or hate speech, including about race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, sexual orientation or disability.
- Criticise gameplay, not people.
- Report problems instead of retaliating.
## Protect privacy
- Never share anyone's real name, address, phone number, social media accounts, face or other personal data, including your own.
- No doxxing, and no attempts to find out who someone is outside the game.
## Play fair
- No cheats, hacks, trainers or exploits that harm other players, and no instructions for them.
- No selling, trading or sharing of game accounts.
## Share only what you may
- Post screenshots and clips you recorded yourself, or content you have permission to share.
- Credit other people's builds and ideas.
## Keep it suitable
- No sexual content, real-world violence or gore, and nothing illegal.
- In-game action and Super Earth satire are fine.
## Roleplay
Treason cases and everything around them follow the [Roleplay Notice](#/legal/roleplay).
## Consequences
Content that breaks these rules is removed. Depending on how serious it is, we warn, suspend or close accounts. Serious threats and illegal content can be reported to the authorities.
## Reporting
Use the report buttons in the app, or email {{email}}.

roleplay.title: Treason & Bounty Roleplay Notice
body: # Treason & Bounty Roleplay Notice
Super Earth always needs a traitor to blame. Super Tracker turns that satire into a game, and it stays a game.
## What is roleplay

Treason cases, jury verdicts, warrants, "traitor" and "servant of freedom" labels, the alignment meter, lobby alerts and the bounty board are fictional and in-universe. They are about how someone played in a match, judged for fun by other players. They are **not** real accusations or statements of fact about real people.
## The rules
1. **Judge gameplay, not people.** A case is about what happened in a mission, nothing else.
2. **No harassment.** Never insult, threaten or pile on anyone, in the app, in the game or anywhere else.
3. **No stalking.** Never follow, search for or join a player across lobbies because of a case or a warrant.

4. **Never ruin a game.** Do not sabotage objectives, kill teammates during a mission or otherwise spoil anyone's match to "carry out a sentence". Roleplay must never cost other players their mission.
5. **Follow the game's rules.** Helldivers 2's own terms and code of conduct always come first.
6. **Stop means stop.** If someone asks you out of character to stop, stop.
7. **No personal data.** Cases name in-game callsigns only.
## Taking part
Features that go beyond a verdict, such as warrants, only apply to players who choose to join Treason roleplay, and anyone can leave it.
## Removal
Anyone named in a case can ask for its removal with the "Request removal" button on the case, or by emailing {{email}}. Cases that break these rules are removed.
